learning_outcomes.text: Classify the types and sources of energy, and define the formation, production and consumption processes.
Identify the interactions between the Earth´s atmospheres with combustion products.
Chose the convenient facilities and techniques necessary to prevent air pollution caused by fuels and combustion.
Identify problems with nuclear power plants and nuclear waste storage.
Describe the potentials and the availability of renewable energy sources.
Describe and choose the methods of energy conservation in homes and industry.
Make the assessment related to energy policies in the world and in our country.

syllabus_topics: Primary and Secondary Energies, Their Use and Environmental Effects
Definitions of Environment and Ecosystem, Concept of Sustainability
Types of energy resources: Formation of fossil, renewable and nuclear energy resources
Production and use of fossil fuels, historical development, fuels and combustion
Definition and Importance of Energy, Energy Crisis in the World
Energy Policies
The structure of the atmosphere and the effects of combustion products. Global warming; Carbon dioxide, water vapor and greenhouse effect relationships.

Fuel and combustion-related air pollution. Precautions, facilities and techniques. Combustion of gaseous and liquid fuels in internal combustion engines. Environmental effects of vehicle pollutants and measures.
Energy Policies in Turkey and the World
Energy Resources
Environmental impacts of nuclear fuel production. Nuclear power plants and nuclear waste storage problem.
Natural resources: Potential and availability of renewable energy sources. Hydroelectric power: availability and environmental effects of hydroelectric plants
Non-renewable and Renewable Energies
Non-renewable Energies
Midterm exam.
Solar energy systems, thermal and photo-electrical usage.
Fossil Energy Types, Combustion and Effects
Coal, Lignite, Natural Gas and Petroleum
Availability and environmental impacts of wind power.
Availability of wave energy. Availability and environmental impacts of geothermal energy.
Renewable and Alternative Energy Sources
Biomass, Solar Energy, Wind Energy
Biological fuels (biomass) production techniques with a zero balance of carbon dioxide.
Residential and industrial energy saving: The applicability of the methods and savings potentials.
Hydraulic Energy, Wave Energy, Geothermal Energy, Hydrogen Energy
Energy Saving, Energy and Environment, Environmental Impacts and Sustainability
Energy resources in the world and in Turkey: Energy production and consumption
Energy policies of Turkey and the World: National legislation and international contracts related to energy and environment.
New Technologies in Energy, Conclusion and Evaluation
bibliography: Energy, the Environment, and Sustainability (Efstathios E. Michaelides)
